notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for joined-federate MOM updates-sent counts. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAvariableArray, HLAfixedRecord, HLAinteger32BE, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application object/interaction names. It verifies standard object publication and registration, reliable and best-effort update accounting, transportation-type change confirmation, nested MOM data-element decoding, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM update-count and transportation-change services with FederateAmbassador report and confirmation callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador MOM, object-management, interaction, transportation, and data-element declarations
